priorityCandidates.finding: Historical Oct 24 phase III noninferiority trial, not a Nov 11 new readout. 972 randomized but 970 analysed (14-day 484, 28-day 486); full eligibility, exact safety denominators, treatment-related deaths and per-protocol/sensitivity NI analysis remain to verify. Primary abstract establishes NI, not OS superiority. Hold complete curation rather than rely on secondary 970-randomized wording.

Single-center retrospective 100-patient surgical case series, 72 colon/28 rectum, no randomized or concurrent comparator. Short-term feasibility cannot establish oncological equivalence or superiority to multiport robotics. Full eligibility, follow-up and complication details remain unverified.

Retrospective 135-patient single-arm cohort; no advantage of a CRM 5 mm threshold demonstrated. Full effect estimates, analysis denominators and safety unavailable; cannot infer robotic superiority or replace randomized surgery evidence.

Single-arm phase II planned 40; ctDNA-positive stage II/III MSS CRC after curative resection and chemotherapy. Registry last updateSep 22 remains NOT_YET_RECRUITING with estimated dates. Collaboration or planned start does not establish enrollment, efficacy or safety; await actual results.
Full correspondence and the exact underlying cohort/consequence are unverified. Do not infer a correction, retraction or a change to reviewed capecitabine trial results from titles alone.

Full original HTML/PDF/tables checked. 87/120 selected surgical patients; 83 postoperative samples, 30 positive/53 negative; sampling 2–26 weeks, before adjuvant treatment, with outcomes measured from surgery. HRs are unadjusted prognostic associations. Pre-CRS OS Cox P=.061 is not conventionally significant. No treatment-selection benefit or safety of omission inferred.

Original publisher abstract labels narrative synthesis with search endingSep 27. Not new ASCOLT or ALASCCA follow-up; no new randomized patient data and no revision to existing negative/unselected aspirin trial conclusions.
